statement_text: SELECT MEASURE(revenue) AS revenue, ship_mode FROM main.sales.revenue_mv WHERE ship_date >= DATE'2026-10-01' GROUP BY ship_mode
SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM main.sales.lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE'2026-10-01'
SELECT AVG(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS avg_revenue_per_line FROM main.sales.lineitem WHERE l_returnflag <> 'R'
